title: MonoSafetyCrossover - LR2 shared-LP design, inverted HP polarity, LR4 build option, block-rate coefficient recompute
description:
Implement Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover only. Shared-LP centered lows + per-channel HP on shifted/delayed highs (§4.5–4.6).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §§4.5 (LR2 math, polarity D2), 4.6 (channel assembly roles), §6 (block-rate coeff), CMake SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER expectation from phase A
- risk_notes: HP polarity inverted; LR2/LR4 by compile option

Implement class MonoSafetyCrossover in Source/DSP/MonoSafetyCrossover.h + MonoSafetyCrossover.cpp:
1. API: prepare(spec/sampleRate), reset(), setCutoffHz(float fc), processBlock or process that can:
   - run the single shared LP on dry mono source x(n) once per sample
   - run HP on left shifted+delayed and right shifted+delayed independently
   Prefer clear methods such as processLowpass(float x)->float and processHighpassL/R(float x)->float, or a structured process(x, wetL, wetR, lpOut, hpLOut, hpROut).
2. LR2 default: two cascaded 1st-order Butterworth sections per band via juce::dsp::IIR::Filter (matched LP/HP). Coefficients from cutoff and sampleRate.
3. Build option: if SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER is defined as 4 (or == 4), use LR4 — two cascaded 2nd-order Butterworth per band (in-phase, 24 dB/oct). Default when undefined or 2 remains LR2. Use #if SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER == 4 (treat missing macro as 2).
4. Highpass polarity inverted internally so degenerate Mix=1, ΔC→0, τ→0 reconstruction is flat rather than notched (D2).
5. Coefficient recompute only when cutoff dirty flag set; apply at block start (setCutoffHz marks dirty; process applies once). Never recompute per-sample.
6. Shared LP is a single filter instance — bit-identical left/right lows by design when assembly later adds the same lp to both channels.
7. RT: fixed state, no heap outside prepare; ScopedNoDenormals is caller's job.

Do not implement other DSP classes, assembly engine, tests, or CMakeLists (b.5 may add compile definition wiring if missing — this task only consumes the macro).
acceptance_criteria: Shared lowpass path is a single instance for dry mono source x(n)
Independent highpass paths exist for L and R wet/shifted inputs
Default path is LR2 (two cascaded 1st-order Butterworth sections per band via juce::dsp::IIR)
SHREDWIDTH_XOVER_ORDER == 4 selects LR4 (two cascaded 2nd-order Butterworth per band)
Coefficients recompute only on dirty cutoff at block boundary, not per-sample
prepare/process/reset present; no allocation outside prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify DelayLineFrac, PitchShifter, WidthProcessor, PluginProcessor, PluginEditor
duplicate LP filter instances per channel

allowed: single process() API packing lp/hp I/O if clearer than split methods
dirty-flag coeff update at start of processBlock-style entry
